### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book suitable for all ages?**
The challenges are designed to appeal to various skill levels, from younger children starting out to older builders looking for complex engineering ideas. Check the specific recommendations if you have age concerns.

**Does this activity book include actual LEGO pieces?**
No, this product is a comprehensive activity and inspiration guide featuring 365 daily construction prompts drawn from popular LEGO themes. It provides the *ideas* for building.

**How do I start using the challenges?**
Simply pick a day! The book presents various themed scenarios (like magic tricks or treasure hunts) that serve as creative starting points for your own brick-built creations.
